excerpt: Learn how to set up your first AI-powered job and start getting results in minutes.
content:
## Welcome to __PROJECT_NAME__

This guide will walk you through setting up your first AI-powered job.

### Step 1: Create an Account

Sign up for a free account to get started. No credit card required.

### Step 2: Submit Your First Job

Navigate to the dashboard and click "New Job". Upload your data or configure the job parameters.

### Step 3: Monitor Progress

Watch your job process in real-time with our live status updates. You'll see progress indicators and can track each step.

### Step 4: Review Results

Once complete, review your AI-generated results. Download reports, view analytics, and take action on the insights.

## What's Next?

Explore our documentation for advanced features like API access, custom models, and batch processing.
